models.name: quadratic_multiscale
models.formula: Existing source-masked asymmetric quadratic maps at full and half resolution, mixed as 0.85*fine + 0.5*half; no Malta directional terms.

models.name: directional_fine
models.formula: Existing source-masked asymmetric quadratic map plus all six libjxl directional Malta costs at full resolution; no half-resolution term.

models.name: directional_multiscale
models.formula: Existing full directional maps at full and half resolution, mixed as 0.85*fine + 0.5*half. This is the previously validated expensive reference model.

plan.pooling: All three maps use maximum and native fixed-p=3 pooling: (L3 + L6 + L12)/3. Half-resolution inputs average linear RGB before adaptation. No fitted weights or new constants.
plan.inputs: Exactly 800 previously scored diagnostic reconstructions from sixteen frozen development photos at distances 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 7. Repeated identical PNGs may reuse a score within the same source photo; all 800 observations remain reported.

cohorts.name: actual
cohorts.definition: Aligned actual to predictor actual at each photo and distance.

cohorts.name: restorations
cohorts.definition: Within each saved mode, actual to each fixed X/Y/B/all restoration at each photo and distance.

gate.rule: A model must pass each cohort separately on both Butteraugli metrics. Native percentages divide by the before score. Prediction is after minus before model score; use the existing predictionAgreement implementation. Report both native direction counts, trivial baselines, false alarms, abstentions and missed harms. Do not select only favorable channels or distances.

plan.scope: One owner-approved screen of at most three formulas; no encoder changes, new images, native scoring, fitting, peer decisions, joint RD or holdout access. No independent development validation is authorized in this round. A survivor is only eligible to propose later validation; it is not a promoted encoder policy.
plan.cost: Diagnostic elapsed times may be recorded as overlapping run receipts only, not isolated encoder speed, speed allowance or managed-memory qualification.
plan.stop: Stop after the three fixed models, evidence checks and report. Keep all production and promotion gates unchanged.

assessmentSummary.policy: Only actual and restorations rows enter decisions. All, per-photo and per-variant rows are descriptive, not selection opportunities. Criteria and models remain unchanged from plan.json.
assessmentSummary.limits: Sixteen previously inspected screen photos; strongly correlated distances, modes and counterfactuals. A passing model is only a candidate for later independent development validation. No encoder or speed qualification.

archive.policy: Six first-party offline scripts and the fixed plan. Imports and self-receipt paths are normalized for a scratch checkout. Existing attributed perceptual ports are imported unchanged; no new source port.
